purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) system used in Japanese medical billing. It handles individual receipt data display/instruction (レセ電データ個別指示) within the general billing/public expense claim subsystem. It manages screen navigation, initialization, data retrieval from various master tables (patient info, job management, receipt management), and batch print job control for medical insurance claims.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as garbled latin-1 characters. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the open-source JMA ORCA project (circa 2002+). The MCP middleware pattern is characteristic of the ORCA system's Gtk/PostgreSQL-based architecture rather than CICS. Program ID ORCGT06 fits the ORCA naming convention for screen transaction modules.
